About this page

Health Check-up & Treatment Packages at Phyathai 1 - Phyathai Hospital

A comprehensive catalog of Phyathai's health check-up and treatment packages — annual physicals, condition-specific screening, diagnostic and treatment programs — with seasonal promotions for every age group from children and working adults to seniors and families. Pricing is transparent, and most packages are eligible for insurance reimbursement.

Package categories

  • Annual physical — tailored by age and gender
  • Cardiac screening — ECG, vascular assessment
  • Cancer screening — breast, cervical, colorectal, liver
  • Antenatal care — from conception through delivery
  • Vaccination — adult, pediatric, senior
  • Surgical & treatment packages — fixed-price transparent pricing
  • Pre-travel medical screening
  • Senior wellness — full multi-system check

Why Phyathai packages

Each package is designed by Phyathai's specialist physicians and delivered with modern equipment and technology. Pricing is transparent with no hidden fees, multiple payment options are supported, and the booking system handles both Thai and international patients. As part of the BDMS network, Phyathai operates across multiple branches in Bangkok.

Phyathai Hospital branches

The Phyathai Hospital group operates six hospitals across Bangkok and the Eastern Seaboard, with care coordinated across the network so patients can move seamlessly between facilities for specialist services.

  • Phyathai 1 — Ratchathewi, Bangkok
  • Phyathai 2 — Phaya Thai, Bangkok
  • Phyathai 3 — Phasi Charoen, Bangkok
  • Phyathai Nawamin — Bueng Kum, Bangkok
  • Phyathai Phaholyothin — Phaholyothin Road, Bangkok
  • Phyathai Sriracha — Sriracha District, Chonburi

Request package details or book today — call 1772.
